patterns.note: An asymmetrical two-column grid is frequently used, featuring large, full-bleed color blocks and images that create a dynamic and modern composition.
High contrast typography pairs oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings with smaller, more traditional sans-serif body text, establishing a clear visual hierarchy.
A stark, high-contrast palette is dominated by vibrant red and black, set against a consistent light, warm grey background, creating a bold and memorable brand identity.
The initial large, minimal header with the distinctive script logo transforms into a compact, sticky navigation bar with additional links and social icons as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections and specific call-to-action elements, such as the crowdfunding notice, reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes, primarily alternating between the light grey and vibrant red, providing strong visual segmentation.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero area, potentially a video (as hinted by 'video-hero'), establishes the site's visual identity immediately upon load.

The navigation system features an initial large, prominent logo and minimal links that transform into a compact, sticky header with additional links and social media icons after the user scrolls past the hero section. This transformation involves a change in background, size, and content, likely using CSS transitions or GSAP for smooth animation.

Content sections and specific call-to-action elements are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (likely `gsap` or `css-keyframes` as hinted), appearing with a subtle fade-in or slide-up as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, contrasted with smaller, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, including buttons, image frames, and section blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and title sections, creating a sense of grandeur, transitioning to a more balanced density within content blocks and lists.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of a high-contrast red and black palette against a muted light grey, combined with an asymmetrical grid and oversized typography. The unique, script-like logo element provides a touch of artistic flair that softens the otherwise stark modern aesthetic, creating a memorable and strong brand identity.
